name: Member's Mark Spinach & Artichoke Dip (Deli Tub Warning)
whyItWorks: Stringy artichoke heart bracts and whole spinach leaves combined with sour cream, cream cheese, parmesan, and garlic. Artichokes are notoriously fibrous and tough to digest, posing a major stricture risk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Stricture & Dairy Warning: Strictly avoid. The fibrous stringy artichoke leaves can cause severe blockages.
